args.query: Federal Register final rules significant rules count

sql: SELECT "year", doc_type, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN significant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sig FROM fedregister.fr_documents_significance WHERE "year" >= '2019' AND doc_type IN ('RULE','PRORULE','Rule','Proposed Rule','NOTICE','Notice') GROUP BY "year", doc_type ORDER BY "year", doc_type

SELECT "year", COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN significant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sig FROM fedregister.fr_documents_significance WHERE doc_type='RULE' AND "year" BETWEEN '2010' AND '2018' GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN significant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sig, MAX(publication_date) maxd FROM fedregister.fr_documents_significance WHERE doc_type='RULE' AND "year"='2026' AND publication_date <= '2026-09-30'
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN significant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sig, MAX(publication_date) maxd FROM fedregister.fr_documents_significance WHERE doc_type='RULE' AND "year"='2026'
SELECT "year", COUNT(*) n FROM fedregister.fr_documents WHERE doc_type='PRESDOC' AND "year" IN ('2024','2025','2026') GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"
